title: Jancovici : Can we save energy, jobs and growth at the same time ? 08/01/2018
summary: Jean-Marc Jancovici lectures at ENS Paris on whether energy use, jobs and growth can all be preserved. He argues for a physical approach to economics, since resource depletion and climate limits make perpetual GDP growth unrealistic.
why: Recommended as a sober, physics-based account of how energy underlies the economy.

quote.text: this doc illustrates the enormous realities of energy challenges with sober clarity often exposed by Jancovici
